_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Firebase/GCP project the deploy tooling (and deploy/store/gate.py) targets. `active` names the PRODUCTION project: flipping it from "current" to "new" is the cutover switch for deploy/. Any single run can still override the target with FIREBASE_PROJECT=<id|current|new> or --project=<id>. See docs/PROJECT_MIGRATION.md.
_apps_comment: `apps` names the project the INSTALLED mobile apps talk to (deploy/store/gate.py moves the force-update gate there). It stays "current" until a new app build pointing at the new project ships; it must match my_flutter_app/lib/firebase_environment_options.dart defaultEnvironment (production=current, new=new).
